classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught reverse-GST procedure to each inclusive price, dividing by 11 and multiplying by 10, with cent rounding where required.

content.prompt: For each of the following items, the cost including GST is given. Calculate the cost before GST was added. Give monetary answers to the nearest cent where necessary.

answer.worked:
The GST-inclusive price represents $110\%$ of the pre-GST price.
$$\begin{align*}110\%&=\$715\\10\%&=\$715\div11=\$65\\100\%&=\$65\times10=\$650\end{align*}$$
The cost before GST was \$650.

The GST-inclusive price represents $110\%$ of the pre-GST price.
$$\begin{align*}110\%&=\$495\\10\%&=\$495\div11=\$45\\100\%&=\$45\times10=\$450\end{align*}$$
The cost before GST was \$450.

The GST-inclusive price represents $110\%$ of the pre-GST price.
$$\begin{align*}110\%&=\$18\\10\%&=\$\frac{18}{11}\\100\%&=\$\left(\frac{18}{11}\times10\right)=\$\frac{180}{11}\\100\%&\approx\$16.36\end{align*}$$
The cost before GST was \$16.36 to the nearest cent.

The GST-inclusive price represents $110\%$ of the pre-GST price.
$$\begin{align*}110\%&=\$2400\\10\%&=\$\frac{2400}{11}\\100\%&=\$\left(\frac{2400}{11}\times10\right)=\$\frac{24000}{11}\\100\%&\approx\$2181.82\end{align*}$$
The cost before GST was \$2181.82 to the nearest cent.
